subject: MedTech Forward 2026: please upload your presentation by the published deadline
body:
Hi Osei,

You're presenting at MedTech Forward 2026 — Sensor Talk — linked video in Room 210 on 2026-03-11 17:00.

Please upload your presentation by the published deadline using your personal secure link. No account is needed.

http://localhost:3001/t/7264eb8c-7aa1-4b70-a54c-ccae0e701f3e

Requirements: 16:9 widescreen, PowerPoint (.pptx) preferred, PDF accepted. Embed all fonts and use H.264 .mp4 for video.

The DXG presentation team
